prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
The Liberal Democrats offer a strong, principled opposition to an overmighty Conservative government and a failing Labour Party. Rooted in the values of openness, tolerance and unity, they champion civil liberties, opportunity for young people, environmental leadership and a fair, modern economy.

Europe and Brexit
- Stop a hard Brexit and keep Britain close to Europe; guarantee EU citizens’ rights and protect UK citizens in the EU.
- Hold a referendum on the final deal with the option to remain.
- Prioritise single market and customs union membership, freedom of movement, police and security cooperation, Erasmus+, research funding, and high social and environmental standards.
- Respect Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland and Gibraltar’s interests.

NHS and Social Care
- Immediate 1p on Income Tax to raise £6bn ringfenced for the NHS and social care; develop a dedicated health and care tax.
- Parity for mental health with new waiting-time standards; end out-of-area placements and improve crisis care.
- Integrate health and social care (“home not hospital”); cap care costs; support carers; end NHS staff pay freeze; protect EU staff; reinstate student nurse bursaries.

Education and Young People
- Nearly £7bn extra: protect per-pupil funding, expand the Pupil Premium, fair national funding.
- High-quality early years: triple Early Years Pupil Premium; boost qualified staff.
- Oppose new grammars; restore local accountability; ensure SEND support.
- End 1% teacher pay cap; fund professional development; tackle workload.
- Rich, modern curriculum incl. PSHE/SRE, arts and technical skills; better careers advice.
- Restore maintenance grants; review HE finance; protect universities from hard Brexit.
- Lifelong learning and apprenticeships; tackle basic skills by 2030.

Economy and Work
- Balance day-to-day budget by 2020; invest £100bn in infrastructure (300,000 homes/year, fibre-to-premises broadband, transport, renewables).
- Fair taxes: crack down on avoidance, reverse unfair Tory cuts; review business rates; explore land value taxation.
- Back SMEs and start-ups (British Business Bank expansion, start-up allowance); modernise worker rights; curb zero-hours abuses; promote a living wage and pay transparency.
- Spread prosperity via devolution, local banking, and regional investment.

Green Britain
- Five green laws; 4m home insulation retrofits by 2022; zero-carbon homes standard restored.
- Clean air plan: diesel scrappage and end sales of new diesel cars/vans by 2025; expand ultra-low-emission zones; EV infrastructure.
- 60% renewable electricity by 2030; no fracking; support tidal, wind, storage; keep Euratom.
- Nature protection, flood resilience, greener farming focused on public benefits; Zero-Waste Act.

Families, Housing, Transport
- Expanded free childcare (from nine months for working parents on the path to 30 hours); stronger Shared Parental Leave; flexible work as a day-one right.
- Fair welfare: uprate benefits, scrap bedroom tax, reverse punitive cuts.
- Housing: 300,000 homes/year, 10 new garden cities, lift council borrowing caps, Rent to Own, renters’ rights, tackle rough sleeping (Housing First).
- Modern transport: HS2/HS3/Crossrail 2; rail reform; bus discount card (16–21); cycling and walking.

Rights, Justice, Immigration
- Defend the Human Rights Act and ECHR; digital bill of rights; tougher action on hate crime; humane refugee policy (50,000 Syrians; 3,000 Dubs children).
- Equality for women, BAME and LGBT+ communities; modernise gender recognition; mixed-sex civil partnerships.
- Criminal justice focused on rehabilitation; decriminalise drug possession and regulate cannabis.
- Positive, managed immigration: efficient visas, remove students from targets, STEM post-study visas, Migration Impact Fund, ESOL; end indefinite detention (28-day limit).

Global Role and Political Reform
- Defend multilateralism; spend 0.7% on aid; tighten arms exports (suspend to Saudi).
- Commit 2% GDP to defence; cyber security; minimum nuclear deterrent on reduced posture.
- Fix politics: STV for Commons and local elections; votes at 16; reform the Lords; federal UK with meaningful devolution; oppose a second Scottish independence referendum.
